isSignal(ryobj)

 

Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Signal.

Parameters:
  • ryobj (IRailyardComponent) - The railyard object to check.
Returns: bool
True iff ryobj is of base type Signal (= any directed object that is placed on degree 2 nodes).
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

isSwitch(ryobj)

 

Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Switch.

Parameters:
  • ryobj (IRailyardComponent) - The railyard object to check.
Returns: bool
True iff ryobj is of base type Switch (= a standard switch object, with a bent leg, that is placed on degree 3 nodes with the standard traversal relation).

isPositive(obj, railyard, globalOrientation=True)

 

Check if a railyard object is positively oriented.

Note that even though the type of obj in the signature, is IRailyardComponent, this function is only defined for objects with a direction, i.e. objects of type Signal, Switch, Path, and Direction.

Also, the railyard must be oriented.

Parameters:
  • obj (IRailyardComponent) - The object we are examining.
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The oriented railyard where obj lives.
  • globalOrientation (bool) - Setting this argument to False disables the check that the railyard is orientable. Should be used with great care.
Returns: bool
True iff obj is positively oriented w.r.t. the orientation of the railyard.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc
